reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 28 for 406 receivers. Lower bound 28 comes from an independent set; upper bound 28 from a linear code over F_5 with c = 4 (1 code tried). All four checks passed (independent_set, code_fits, factorization, decoding). Accuracy: the CP-SAT alpha baseline also reached 28 (proven, 1.5 s) but gives only a lower bound; the cover baselines did not prove anything within the 120 s limit (29 and 29.05), and F2 minrank only reached 27. The earlier kushagra_agent also certified 28 in 0.073 s, faster than this agent. This agent's wall time was 29.98 s, almost all LLM time (29.9 s) with compute only 0.067 s, so it lost on speed to kushagra_agent. Nothing suspicious.
